content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Many digital creators in West Africa encounter financial isolation due to the unavailability of mainstream platforms. Conventional payment processors impose geographic restrictions, leaving you without viable options for receiving payments. COREMERCH's infrastructure eliminates these barriers by leveraging blockchain technology. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you have access to a global market. This sovereignty means you own your entire stack, ensuring that no external platform can restrict your access or control your funds.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Prior to deployment, ensure you have your digital products ready. This includes ebooks, courses, or any digital assets you plan to sell. Familiarize yourself with platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, as these are fundamental to building your stack. Additionally, gather your cryptocurrency wallet information and decide which blockchain you'll use—consider USDT on Tron for its fast settlement times and low fees. By preparing these elements, you set the stage for a seamless deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by establishing your payment processing mechanism. Utilize NOWPayments to integrate cryptocurrency payment options into your online store. This setup allows you to receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. Pair this with a delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure your products are accessible immediately after purchase. This combination guarantees a smooth transaction process for your customers and enhances their purchasing experience.
Leverage blockchain technology to bypass payment platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is configured, it's time to go live. Publish your website on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, making it accessible to your audience. Share your store link through social media or relevant platforms to drive traffic. Process your first transaction by purchasing one of your products, ensuring that the payment is automatically confirmed by NOWPayments. This initial transaction will validate your setup and provide insights into customer behavior, allowing you to optimize your offerings.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure successfully deployed, focus on scaling your operations. Start by adding more products to your store; the Edge Commerce Stack allows you to load up to five products seamlessly. Utilize analytics tools to understand customer interactions and adjust your marketing strategies accordingly. Consider expanding your payment options by integrating more cryptocurrencies, as this will attract a wider audience. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional templates and blueprints to further enhance your infrastructure, ensuring you are well-equipped for growth.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Enjoy full ownership of your digital commerce stack with no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
